manifest.subject: english

units.name: 专项测验
units.title: Fun Clubs 社团选择与能力表达专项测验
units.desc: 针对人教版2024新教材七年级上册 Unit 5 Fun Clubs 的高难度变式测验，覆盖社团与活动词汇、情态动词 can、交际句型以及关于校园社团的跨文化阅读语篇。

exercises.question:
— What club do you want to join?
— I like painting and drawing, so I want to join the ______.
exercises.explanation: 句意为：——你想加入什么社团？——我喜欢画画，所以我想加入美术社。painting and drawing 对应 art club。故选 B。易错点：混淆 music club（音乐社）和 chess club（棋类社）的活动内容。

exercises.question:
用 can 的正确形式填空。
— ______ you play the guitar?
— No, I ______. But I ______ sing English songs.
exercises.explanation: 第一空询问能力，用 Can 引导一般疑问句，首字母大写；第二空否定回答，用 can't；第三空表示“会”，用 can。考察 can 的疑问句、否定句和肯定句的综合运用。

exercises.question:
— Can she dance?
— ______. She is in the dance club.
exercises.explanation: 句意为：——她会跳舞吗？——是的，她会。她在舞蹈社。根据 She is in the dance club 可知，她会跳舞。Can she...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, she can. 故选 A。易错点：混淆 can 和 do/does 的回答形式。

exercises.question: 在短语 'sit down' 中，/t/ 音需要完全读出来。
exercises.explanation: sit 以爆破音 /t/ 结尾，down 以爆破音 /d/ 开头。两个爆破音相遇时，前面的 /t/ 失去爆破，只做口型不发音，不需要完全读出来。故本题错误。考察不完全爆破规则。

exercises.question:
根据答语补全问句，每空一词。
— ______ ______ can you play?
— I can play basketball and football.
exercises.explanation: 答语 I can play basketball and football. 回答的是运动项目，因此问句应为 What sports can you play?。考察特殊疑问句与能力表达的结合。

options: A. She can sing well, but she can't play the piano.
B. She can sings well, but she can't play the piano.
C. She can sing well, but she can't plays the piano.
D. She can sings well, but she can't plays the piano.
exercises.question:
下面句子有一处语法错误，请选择正确的句子。
She can sings well, but she can't plays the piano.
exercises.explanation: can 和 can't 是情态动词，后面必须接动词原形，不能加 -s。原句两处错误（sings 和 plays）。故选 A。逆向思维：根据错误句子反推情态动词的语法规则。

options: A. What club do you want to join?
E. Why do you like English?
exercises.question:
Choose TWO correct sentences to complete the dialogue.
— Hi, Lucy. 1. ______
— I want to join the English club.
— 2. ______
— Yes, I can. I can speak English well.
exercises.explanation: 第一空：根据答语 I want to join the English club. 可知，问句是询问想加入的社团，A 符合；第二空：根据答语 Yes, I can. 可知，问句是 Can 引导的一般疑问句，B 符合。C 是 Do 引导的疑问句，回答用 Yes, I do；D 是特殊疑问句，不能用 Yes 回答；E 询问原因，回答用 Because。考察交际语境与 can 疑问句的综合。

exercises.question:
阅读英国学校社团招募广告，判断下列句子是否正确，正确写 T，错误写 F。
Welcome to Greenfield School! We have many fun clubs for you.
Chess Club: Do you like playing chess? Come and join us! We meet on Wednesday afternoons. Please call Mr. Black at 555-0123.
Drama Club: Can you act? Do you like telling stories? Join the drama club! We meet on Friday afternoons. Please email Ms. Green at green@example.com.
Photography Club: Do you have a camera? Can you take photos? We meet on Monday afternoons. Please call Mr. White at 555-0456.
(1) The Chess Club meets on Monday afternoons. (2) You can email Ms. Green to join the Drama Club. (3) The Photography Club needs students who can take photos.
exercises.explanation: 由 Chess Club 广告中 'We meet on Wednesday afternoons.' 可知(1)F；由 Drama Club 广告中 'Please email Ms. Green at green@example.com.' 可知(2)T；由 Photography Club 广告中 'Can you take photos?' 可知(3)T。考察阅读细节提取与跨文化语境理解。

exercises.question:
阅读短文，用适当的词填空。
My name is Peter. I am a student in London. I ______ (1) (can) play the piano, but I ______ (2) (can not) play the guitar. I want ______ (3) (join) the music club because I like music.
exercises.explanation: 第一空表示“会”，用 can；第二空表示“不会”，用 can't；第三空 want to do sth. 想要做某事，用 to join。考察情态动词 can 与固定搭配的综合运用。

options: B. To ask students to join the clubs.
C. To show the teachers' abilities.
exercises.question: What is the main purpose of these club ads?
exercises.explanation: 这三则广告分别介绍了社团的活动时间、联系方式及要求，目的是招募学生加入社团。故选 B。考察阅读主旨与写作意图推断。
